business_legal_profiles_company_number_c.name: business_legal_profiles_company_number_check
business_legal_profiles_company_number_c.value:
("business_legal_profiles"."entity_type" in ('limited_company', 'limited_liability_partnership') and ("business_legal_profiles"."company_number" = '' or "business_legal_profiles"."company_number" ~ '^([0-9]{8}|[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6})$'))
      or ("business_legal_profiles"."entity_type" not in ('limited_company', 'limited_liability_partnership') and "business_legal_profiles"."company_number" = '')

loyalty_offers_usage_check.name: loyalty_offers_usage_check
loyalty_offers_usage_check.value: ("loyalty_offers"."usage_limit" is null and "loyalty_offers"."usage_period" is null) or ("loyalty_offers"."usage_limit" > 0 and "loyalty_offers"."usage_period" is not null)

loyalty_offers_dates_check.name: loyalty_offers_dates_check
loyalty_offers_dates_check.value: "loyalty_offers"."ends_at" is null or "loyalty_offers"."starts_at" is null or "loyalty_offers"."ends_at" > "loyalty_offers"."starts_at"

loyalty_programs_dates_check.name: loyalty_programs_dates_check
loyalty_programs_dates_check.value: "loyalty_programs"."ends_at" is null or "loyalty_programs"."starts_at" is null or "loyalty_programs"."ends_at" > "loyalty_programs"."starts_at"

posts_event_dates_check.name: posts_event_dates_check
posts_event_dates_check.value:
(
        "posts"."kind" = 'news'
        and "posts"."event_starts_at" is null
        and "posts"."event_ends_at" is null
        and "posts"."event_timezone" is null
        and "posts"."event_venue_name" is null
        and "posts"."event_venue_address" is null
        and "posts"."event_cancelled_at" is null
      ) or (
        "posts"."kind" = 'event'
        and "posts"."event_starts_at" is not null
        and "posts"."event_timezone" is not null
        and ("posts"."event_ends_at" is null or "posts"."event_ends_at" > "posts"."event_starts_at")
      )

reviews_target_check.name: reviews_target_check
reviews_target_check.value: ("reviews"."target" = 'business' and "reviews"."menu_item_id" is null) or ("reviews"."target" = 'menu_item' and "reviews"."menu_item_id" is not null)
